summary: @galicia-toolkit-nestjs/commons exfiltrates CI/cloud credentials via preinstall native binary
details: The package ships an opaque prebuilt native addon at `prebuilds/<platform>-x64/metrics.node` with no corresponding source and no `binding.gyp`. `package.json` declares `preinstall: node index.js || true`, and `index.js` resolves and `require()`s the platform-specific `metrics.node` on both install and any `require()` of the package. The native binary reads a hardcoded list of credential-bearing environment variables — including `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, `AWS_SESSION_TOKEN`, `GITHUB_TOKEN`, `NPM_TOKEN`, `NODE_AUTH_TOKEN`, `SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN`, `ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN`, `ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN`, `AZURE_DEVOPS_EXT_PAT` — along with repository/build identifiers, hostname, username, and cwd, and transmits them via raw TCP `POST /native HTTP/1.0` to the hardcoded host `oob.s4yhii.com`. The `|| true` on the preinstall hook silently swallows errors so the install still reports success. The package name uses a private-looking scope with an implausibly high version (`999.0.8`), consistent with dependency-confusion targeting of an internal `@galicia-toolkit-nestjs/*` namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
